ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $C$ is a point on line segment $AD$, $B$ is the midpoint of $CD$, and $AD=13\, \text{cm}$, $BC=3\, \text{cm}$. What is the length of $AC$ in centimeters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $B$ is the midpoint of $CD$, and $BC=3\text{cm}$, \\
then $CD=2BC=6\text{cm}$. \\
Since $AD=13\text{cm}$, \\
then $AC=AD-CD=13-6=\boxed{7}\text{cm}$.
